name: software-factory
description: A software factory in one command. /factory takes a feature, or every unit of an ADR in build order, through a spec (with an optional human gate), a build, parallel reviews (security, UX, UI, code, test quality with mutation checks, and WCAG 2.2 AA on UI changes) and an approver, then merges it or opens a preview PR, shepherds the PR until CI is green, and learns lessons from every job that needed a second try. Works in any repo; a live dashboard shows every job.
